title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — November 06, 2026

There’s been some elevated solar activity today, so here’s a look at the outer corona.

🔥 Strongest recent flare: M3.5

I'm watching the corona today.

Today’s solar images show a broad dark coronal-hole-like region alongside several bright active-region loop systems, with modest sunspot coverage.

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-1
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
